title: Belkis Ertegun's chauffeured Rolls Royce to the doctor
summary: Marge called Belkis Ertegun about getting Zutty through the snow to the doctor and the next day a chauffeured Rolls Royce arrived, with daughter Alma along.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Zutty in. I called the (Turk Hertigan?) because as I tell you, there was snow on the ground and I told ....

And I told (Belkiss?) how sick Zutty was and I had to take him to the doctor. I said and there's so much snow and ice on the ground I don't know, I said, it's hard to get a cab. She said, don't worry about a thing. What time do you have to be there? And I told her two o'clock. She said, well we'll have a car and a chauffeur there.
I think it would be nice to just put on here you know, about Nesuhi. Ma
Oh yes indeed. And the next day about two o'clock her chauffeur was there and helped Zutty out to the car. And Alma was there. And I got in the car and sat down. And I said, what kind of car
is this? And the chauffeur turned around and he said, it's a Rolls Royce. (LAUGHTER).
